about_the_game:
In the Lust Academy: Season 4 Demo, embark on a mission with your enticing friend Haley as you journey to the Valley of Angels. You aim to stop a dangerous alliance between the Overlord and the Cursed Angels, a race bound by a curse.

What’s included in the demo:

  • Story-driven adventure: experience the beginning of a tense negotiation as you try to warn the Angels about the Overlord's true intentions.

  • Engaging gameplay mechanics: Learn about the Angels’ curse and explore creative ways to interact with their hauntingly beautiful world.

  • Build intimate connections: Forge bonds with Haley and the Angels, uncovering unexplored layers of their sexuality.

  • Magic lessons: Assist Haley in brewing a potion to counteract the Angels' curse and shift the balance of power.

This demo introduces the part of narrative and gameplay of Lust Academy: Season 4, offering a glimpse of the game’s blend of fantasy, intrigue, and adult adventure.

Try to uncover secrets, forge alliances, and set the stage for the epic journey that lies ahead with the full release of Lust Academy Season 4.
